purpose: Five character style samples for comparison; no webpage asset replaced.

variants.title: 01 · 8-bit 街机
variants.style: Strict deliberately hand-drawn low-resolution 8-bit pixel sprite aesthetic, approximately 64x64 source-pixel logic enlarged using hard nearest-neighbor edges. Chunky square pixels, clear stepped diagonals, constrained 12-color palette, no antialiasing, no smooth outline, no glossy eyes. Simplify the plaid to a few pixels without losing the glasses or costume. Thin stepped near-black silhouette with a small electric-blue offset pixel shadow and a few fluorescent-yellow square sparkles.
variants.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Create ONE square concept sample of the exact same personal mascot shown in the reference, for the Urbanview modern street-editorial portfolio. Reference role: character identity and costume ONLY; replace the original smooth chibi rendering with the requested medium. Keep warm light-brown bobbed hair, one upward forelock, tan fox/cat ears, fluffy tan tail, black RECTANGULAR glasses, large dark amber eyes with tiny cyan highlights, grey tailored jacket, pale plaid shirt, small red collar accent, black trousers and red/white sneakers. Friendly clever energy. Composition: one complete full-body character, standing in a lively gentle three-quarter pose, facing viewer and waving, tail clearly visible. Center it with 12% safe padding around every extremity. No duplicate poses, no sheet, no additional character. Plain flat warm-white #f8f4e8 background for comparing styles. Urban accents electric blue #2f54ff, fluorescent yellow #f5ff3d, near-black #11120f, with warm natural hair/skin and restrained red. No text, no captions, no logos, no watermark. variants.title: 02 · 像素街贴
variants.style: Pixel paste-up hybrid. Carefully built approximately 96px sprite with visible crisp square pixel clusters, stepped silhouettes and dithered shading, printed as a die-cut street sticker. Surround the pixel character with a bold irregular fluorescent-yellow die-cut backing rim and electric-blue offset screenprint shadow. Tiny controlled print wear ONLY on the rim, preserve crisp deliberate sprite pixels. The character stays warm and recognizable, the sticker feels contemporary editorial print. Not a smooth cartoon with a pixel filter.

variants.title: 03 · 街头模板喷绘
variants.style: Street stencil artwork translated from this same character. Hard angular cut-paper stencil shapes, charcoal key plate, limited warm ochre hair and skin plate, electric-blue shadow plate, acid-yellow offset accent. Mature graphic reduction, slight misregistration, very restrained dry spray and rough edges contained close to the silhouette. Flat high-contrast planes, sparse negative-space facial shapes; keep the rectangular glasses, expressive eyes, grey jacket, red collar, tan ears and tail. No smooth anime shading, no pixel grid, no graffiti lettering, no wall scene.

variants.title: 04 · 漫画网点贴纸
variants.style: Editorial underground-comic screenprinted sticker. Confident thick black brush-ink contours, expressive but controlled face, warm flat color fills, large deliberate halftone dot shadows, subtle blue/yellow ink misregistration, narrow white die-cut edge plus electric-blue offset shadow. Contemporary alternative comic/zine energy. Visible print texture rather than soft digital airbrush. Keep the waving pose and original costume. Not pixel art, not a smooth kawaii render.

variants.title: 05 · 街头马克笔
variants.style: Hand-painted graffiti character sticker, drawn with confident broad paint-marker outlines and angular energetic strokes. Original mascot identity recognizable, warm hair and tan tail with rough directional marker hatching, grey jacket with simplified sharp folds. Thick near-black slightly irregular outline, electric-blue secondary contour, fluorescent-yellow minimal gestural accent strokes immediately around the character. Small restrained paint drips only at lower sticker edge. Contemporary street-artist sketchbook energy, more spontaneous and graphic than polished chibi. No text or tags, no brick wall, no halftone dots, no pixel grid.
